<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LightningComponentBundle xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <apiVersion>62.0</apiVersion>
    <isExposed>true</isExposed>
    <masterLabel>Integration Transactions (no Apex)</masterLabel>
    <description>Integration Hub transactions of the current record (GraphQL, no Apex). Also fits the transaction page. Admins can retry with a new payload or resend the original.</description>
    <targets>
        <target>lightning__RecordPage</target>
    </targets>
    <targetConfigs>
        <targetConfig targets="lightning__RecordPage">
            <property name="cardTitle" type="String" label="Card title" default="Integration Transactions"/>
            <property name="maxRows" type="Integer" label="Rows to load (max 200)" default="50"/>
            <property name="visibleRows" type="Integer" label="Rows shown before scrolling" default="5"/>
        </targetConfig>
    </targetConfigs>
</LightningComponentBundle>
